title: Seen a GTA 6 money glitch already? Read this first
summary: Before launch, every 'GTA 6 money glitch' is fake. Here is how to spot them after launch too.
body: Until the game unlocks, nobody outside early regions has played it, so pre-launch glitch videos are made up or recycled from GTA V.
- Real glitches show the full UI, the money counter and the console
- Fake ones cut away right before the payout
- Rockstar patches money glitches fast, so check the date
Every hack in this hub is checked before it goes up, and marked when it gets patched.
